description: Prepare a put: borrow a lend asset (lendAsset) against USDG, whose loan buys more USDG and pledges it with your margin, size times the margin in all, in one transaction. It gains as the asset falls, and its loss stops at the margin. Refused above maxCostBps. Use the prepare object of gage_put_quote, without its action. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

lendAsset.description: The asset the put borrows against USDG: a lend asset gage_capabilities lists with a putRouter (its token address)

margin.description: The USDG you put in, raw units (6 decimals): the most the put can lose

maxCostBps.description: Highest loan cost you accept, bps of the amount borrowed; the put is refused above it

size.description: The put's size, 1.1 to 10 with at most two decimals: its whole USDG pledge over the margin you put in (4 = the margin and three times it bought with the loan)

term.description: Loan term in seconds, one of the terms gage_capabilities lists

name: gage_prepare_put_open
title: Prepare: Open a put
